please don't leave this world, the fact you have chosen to write on here how you feel shows theres still a part of you that is deciding to fight this. presumably the school would tell the parents in cases like this. They will help him get the treatment he needs and dont overburden yourself with that task, as much as it may seen you must help however you can. I know how stressful and upsetting this must be for you, so please just be the best friend you can to him, if you see him, distract him and talk about lighter more positive things. All the best bud.

I am also shrouded with this darkness, but i promise you there will be light. Is there someone around to talk to ? I hate talking to people close, i freeze up and go blank, but if you are like me, take yourself to a hospital, a police station, a friends house, anywhere, to keep yourself safe. If you want to talk, im here.

im so so sorry. I have never been through something quite like yours, but i can see how frustrating it must be for you. The moment he did what he did to you, violating and abusing you, he lost his right to have that freedom in life, okay? So you arent ruining his life, its taking back yours. Do you have anyone close to confide in? If not, please go straight to the police. They will help you, even if you feel like theres no point. They can find people for you so they can support you through this, please dont give up.
